connector.name: Seo MCP
connector.registryDescription: Six tools for SEO and AI-readability audits. 91 checks, 11 score modules.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.metricspot.com over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.metricspot, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token from app.metricspot.com/settings/api-keys. Required for 5 of the 6 tools; omit the header to use only run_audit_anonymous.

env.name: MCP_API_KEY
env.description: Your MetricSpot API key (ms_live_...) from app.metricspot.com/settings/api-keys. Required for 5 of the 6 tools; omit to use only run_audit_anonymous (1 audit per IP per 24 hours, no auth).
